results.description: Taseko Mines Ltd is a Canadian mining company. It is principally engaged in the production and sale of metals, as well as related activities, including exploration and mine development, within the province of British Columbia, Canada, and the State of Arizona, the United States. The Gibraltar, Aley, New Prosperity, Yellowhead properties are located in British Columbia whereas Florence copper is in central Arizona.
results.name: Taseko Mines Limited
